Ya Kun is pleased to join the Change for Charity initiative by @comchestsg to encourage spontaneous giving. Through this initiative, we hope to support the national movement that makes giving a part of your every day life. 
100% of funds raised go towards supporting over 200 critical programmes across five causes: children with special needs and youth-at-risk, adults with disabilities, persons with mental health conditions, and seniors and families in need of support. 

To make a difference with us and to empower communities in need, donate your points through the Ya Kun Cherish App. 

Ya Kun will be amplifying the impact of your donation and donate the dollar equivalent for every 50 points donated. 

To track the progress of our campaign, visit: https://yakunfellowship.wixsite.com/communitychest

Last month, Ya Kun collaborated with @jojomama_sg and @the_colourful_mind for a fun and interactive outing.
In this session, participants had a chance to practice money management skills, and Daily Living Skills such as ordering food and dining out in a real-life setting at Ya Kun ARTRA.
.
JOJOMAMA is a social enterprise that empowers Persons With Disabilities (PWDs) to learn crafts and daily living skills, which will subsequently act as a source of meaningful employment for them. 
.
The Colourful Mind is a social enterprise that provides behavioural intervention to individuals with diverse needs, such as Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD).
